decisions.reason: The placard position and customer-facing orientation are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting stainless-steel spouts that resemble the render does not change the existing cleanability or removable-or-flushable cleaning requirements.
The spout material and appearance decision does not modify the existing leak-free sealing behavior.
The source does not alter the requirement to isolate electrical components from leaking liquid.
The approved spout material and render-matching appearance do not change the established splash-control target.
The source approves the stainless-steel render-matching spout proposal but does not necessarily change the existing gravity feed, flow control, or texture-preservation behavior.
The source identifies the operator-side placement of the mixers but does not change bowl capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraints.
The spout configuration decision does not modify mixing quality, foam performance, or whisk geometry.
The source does not specify a new body or accent color, and its render-matching language does not necessarily override the existing beige and green scheme.
The source does not change enclosure thickness, overall size, or accommodation of the deep mixing wells.
The spout material and appearance decision has no effect on the selected 120V wall-power source.
The approved custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout specification necessarily changes the components and materials that the prototype BOM must identify.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please move forward with that and match the render as closely as possible. I really like both the appearance and functionality shown in the render. There is also one change from the rendering: move the plate reading "[CLIENT_NAME_001]'s Matcha Mixer" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will be positioned in front of the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle. I want "[CLIENT_NAME_001]'s Matcha Mixer" oriented toward the customer.

value_updates.spout_selection: custom-fabricated stainless-steel spouts matching the supplied render as closely as possible
